verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a plausible capability for a SaaS research tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only web and mobile UI features, such as uploading sources, chat, Audio and Video Overviews, and exports, and never mentions a first-party command-line interface. The community mention of using gyb and mhonarc to prepare Gmail sources is a user-side workaround with external tools, not an official CLI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
